subject: Renewal conversation: staged Private footprint expansion + egress & KMS notes
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@medora-labs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Medora Labs Procurement <procurement@medora-labs.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + Private footprint expansion — initial ask

Jordan — thanks for the fast responses this quarter. We're coming up on our Nov 15 renewal and the leadership team wants to scope a staged expansion of our Private deployment. High-level asks:
- Add a pair of isolated clusters in us-west to support analytics workloads (expected steady-state ~120 QPS).
- Segment traffic by team (analytics vs. clinical) with strict network egress controls and customer-managed KMS for PHI keys.
- Short maintenance windows during cutover; we prefer a 2-week staging window and then a final 48-hour cutover.

Can Redwood provide: a) a provisional cost estimate for the expanded footprint + term change options (month-to-month vs. 12 month committed pricing), b) a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with timeline, and c) confirmation on whether we can bring our own KMS keys for the new clusters?

Attachment: current-architecture-diagram.png (image/stub)

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Infrastructure, Medora Labs

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@medora-labs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Private footprint expansion — initial ask

Olivia — really appreciate the clarity. High-level: yes, we can support the two isolated clusters and a customer-managed KMS for the new provisioned nodes.
Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly will own a technical MAP and network requirements doc; she can validate firewalls, NATs, and the egress policy model.
2) Marissa will work the commercials — term options, uplift pricing for the dedicated clusters, and a provisioning credit for a two-week staging window.
3) I'll coordinate an internal kickoff and provide an initial ballpark by end of day Thursday.

Kimberly & Marissa — can you confirm availability for a 30-min sync tomorrow (09/28) to review the MAP and the draft SOW items?

Thanks,
Jordan
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@medora-labs.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Private footprint expansion — network & KMS notes

Olivia — quick follow-up from the engineering side. I sketched a MAP and a network checklist and attached both (MAP_v2.xlsx, network-requirements.pdf). Top technical constraints we need confirmed before we size the clusters: 
- Are the analytics workloads tolerant of cross-cluster KV cache warmup? If not, we'll size for higher memory and pre-warm KV caches.
- Will Medora provide a dedicated egress IP range and route to a proxy? We prefer a /29 peered route for lock-down.
- KMS: we support Bring-Your-Own-Key via our KMS integration but require a rollover window and an HSM-validated certificate (we will share the template).

Dev — please look at the expected QPS and the cache-hot-start note and flag any GPU vs CPU hosting decisions. If analytics is bursty, we should propose a burst-capacity block for the first 90 days.

Proposed time for the 30-min sync: 2026-09-28 10:00 AM PT — please confirm.

Attachment stubs: MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), network-requirements.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Kimberly
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: sizing + provisioning credit recommendation

Team — quick internal note (forward to Olivia after you align on price). Observations:
- If analytics won't accept KV cache warmup, plan: 2x rtx-accelerated instance groups (8 GPU equivalent total) + 512GB aggregate KV memory for the two clusters. Estimated steady-state token capacity covers ~120 QPS at P95 latency targets.
- Recommend a 10% uplift for burst-capacity reserve for first 90 days (billed as committed burst units).
- Provisioning credit: propose one week of waived usage (equivalent to $12,000) for the two-week staging window — good commercial to accelerate sign-off.

Open questions for legal/commercial: do we need an SLA exception for a planned 48-hour cutover? If so, Marissa can draft an SLA carveout with a rollback clause.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@medora-labs.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Medora Labs Procurement <procurement@medora-labs.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Private footprint expansion — proposed commercial + next steps

Olivia — thanks for the patience while we pulled numbers together. Summary of the proposed commercials and timeline (attached provisioning-timeline.csv):
- Offer A (12-month committed): includes the two isolated clusters + KMS integration + 90-day burst reserve; list price $312,000/yr, with a one-week provisioning credit applied on the first invoice.
- Offer B (month-to-month): list price $345,000/yr equivalent (no provisioning credit).
- SLA during cutover: we can accommodate a timeboxed 48-hour cutover with an SLA carveout; Redwood will provide a rollback plan and a single-point technical lead for the migration window.

Next steps:
1) Review the attached MAP_v2.xlsx and provisioning timeline.
2) If acceptable, I'll issue an updated renewal amendment and DocuSign link by EOD Monday with the 12-month committed option pre-selected.
3) We will schedule the technical pre-cutover runbook with Dev within two weeks of contract signature.

Attachments: provisioning-timeline.csv (text/csv)
Related link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1298 (internal ticket for cluster provisioning)

If procurement wants a short call to walk terms, I'm available Wednesday afternoon 10/06.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
